intent: A sun-priestess's ceremonial gown of the old Grashan ruins: pale fluted stone tiers splaying into a wide terracotta hem band over a plains-green petticoat, a wide terracotta sash and a gold sun halo, reading from the high camera as a narrow-shouldered pale bell under a gold crown.
requests: A neck or collar body part: a high standing collar would bury itself in the head, so the collar is a flat gold neckline.
A cone or tapered-box part: the bell is stepped tiers because every panel is a straight box.
A brighter gold material: with no specular light, the sun gold has to live entirely in its colour.
